thread:
cs-jen: heads-up: Acme seeing a spike of 503s on /v1/generate since 09:15 UTC. CS on a call in 10. Customers report timeouts + request failures. Some say they get 500s intermittently. escalation :rotating_light:
ops-bot: alert: hosted-infer-prod: worker-crash x8 in 5m on pool gpu-pool-3 (oom + segfault). links: logs.redwood/s/hosted-infer-prod/alerts/1703056789
maya: looking now. I can see repeated SIGSEGV in infer-runner logs on gpunode-47 at ~09:14-09:18. NVML mem usage jumps to >95% right before the crashes.
liam: was there a recent quantization or model swap?
maya: yes — we hot-swapped quant v2 -> v3 at 08:50 to cut memory. Might be related.
sophie: pulling stack + nvml dumps. quick snippet from /var/log/infer-runner.log:
```
[09:14:21] infer-runner[3421]: mem_total=32GB mem_used=31.8GB mem_free=200MB
[09:14:22] infer-runner[3421]: ATTEN: invalid read at attention_kernel.cu:1240
[09:14:22] infer-runner[3421]: signal 11 (SIGSEGV) pid=3421
[09:14:22] system: Container exit code=139 OOM?
```
cs-jen: customers on enterprise tier are seeing higher error rate. Billing/auth calls that fan out to generation are failing too. Any quick fallback we can do?
maya: short-term: route heavy routes to smaller model or CPU fallback. e.g. `routing set --pool gpu-pool-3 --fallback gpt-small-emb --pct 100` (will shift traffic off the affected GPU pool).
liam: i'm rolling back quantization on one rack (gpunode-46) to compare. starting rollback now.
sophie: tried `gcore 3421` to get a core but process dies mid-dump. attaching raw nvml sample (short):
``
GPU 0: pid=3421 name=infer-runner mem=31800MB, utilization=98%
GPU 0: ECC errors=0, temperature=77C
```
maya: mitigation checklist: 1) reroute traffic, 2) cordon problematic nodes, 3) roll back quant change, 4) collect cores & kernel logs, 5) revert hot swap if repro. Doing 1 and 2 now.
gpu-team: recommend throttling large-batch endpoints while we investigate. set `max_batch_size` from 512 -> 256 and drop `max_concurrency` for embed endpoints.
ops-bot: re-routing 12% of traffic to fallback pool and marking gpunode-47 cordoned. health checks: fallback healthy.
maya: repro command I used locally to trigger memory climb: `ab -n 1000 -c 50 -p payload_large.json https://hosted.internal/v1/embeddings` — produces mem climb within ~40 concurrent requests.
liam: note: quant v3 introduces a different attention kernel that increases transient memory for KV cache. suspect kernel boundary read. will open a debug build with sanitizer on one node.
sophie: collecting full kernel stack, will upload to `s3://redwood-debug/oom/1703056789/` once available.
cs-jen: i'll brief Acme and tell them we routed to fallback and engineering is investigating. any ETA for a safe rollback patch?
liam: expect rollback and patch verification in ~35-45m. if rollback mitigates, we'll escalate to a patch release. updating incident channel.
ops-bot: incident label P1-hosted-503 assigned -> owners: maya, liam. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oom-segfault-hosted-infer (internal).
gpu-team: after rollback, we should add a canary that runs mem-stress for 10m before full rollout.
cs-jen: thanks all — i'll keep CS looped. will post customer-facing note after next update.
